messages:
anna_fin: Heads-up: INV-11022 (SolsticeAI) payment attempt failed — gateway returned 'challenge_required' (3DS/SCA) and our checkout didn't surface the bank challenge. Customer is EU-based and onboarding tomorrow.

ryan_ae: On a call with them now. They use a corporate card tied to a French bank that requires SCA for remote merchant redirects. The procurement team can't complete the redirect from their proxyed environment.

payments-bot: Webhook: gateway=Adyen, decline_code=`challenge_required`, attempt_id=at_247800, time=2026-04-05T09:42Z. Auto-retry scheduled in 6h (rty_247800). Recommendation: pause retries if you plan a manual SCA flow.

luca_ops: This is different from AVS/BIN mismatches — the card is fine but bank requires an interactive challenge. Short term options: 1) send an SCA redirect URL to the cardholder (one-time link) so they can complete auth, 2) accept SEPA Instant via our EU PSP (if they can pay from their company account), or 3) wire. Which does customer want?

anna_fin: Pause the auto-retry for now. Ryan, can AE ask procurement if there's a cardholder who can complete SCA? If not, we should offer SEPA Instant as fastest non-card path.

ivy_support: Customer (seb_cust) replied in support: "We can't open bank challenge in procurement proxy. We can do SEPA transfer or provide the cardholder's mobile to receive the challenge, but that requires internal approval. Can you send invoice details for bank transfer?"

ryan_ae: I'll ask if a cardholder can do the 3DS flow. If not, they'll do SEPA. SEPA instant is fine — ask them to include INV-11022 in the transfer reference so accounting can reconcile.

payments-bot: Created manual_collect job `manual_collect_11022`. Suggested tags: `sca-pending` and `onboarding-hold`. Reminder: if you accept bank transfer, disable scheduled retry to avoid duplicate captures.

luca_ops: Ops action items: 1) add telemetry event `decline_reason=challenge_required` capturing `gateway`, `card_country`, `merchant_country`, 2) add invoice UI hint when SCA likely (e.g., EU card + merchant remote checkout): "Your card may require bank challenge — try SEPA/Bank transfer or ask the cardholder to complete authentication." 3) add a support template for sending one-time SCA links to cardholders that includes expiry window.

anna_fin: I'll pause retry and add invoice tag `manual-ops-hold`. Ryan, send SEPA details and KYC checklist; waive manual fee for this first onboarding attempt.

ivy_support: Drafting message to customer: "Hi Seb — we can offer two quick options: 1) We can send a one-time SCA authentication link to the cardholder (valid 10 minutes) so they can complete the bank challenge, or 2) Pay via SEPA Instant bank transfer. If SEPA, please include INV-11022 in the payment reference and upload remittance/PO to https://support.redwood.ai/portal/upload. SEPA (EUR) instructions: Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.; IBAN: GB33FCB12345678901234; BIC: FCBGB2L; Reference: INV-11022 / SolsticeAI. We'll waive the one-time processing fee for onboarding."

Customer replied: "We'll run SEPA now and send receipt."

payments-bot: Reminder: when SEPA posts, mark via `payments:mark-paid INV-11022 txn=<bank_txn_id>` and include `manual_waiver=onboarding-sca-waive` in metadata to help revenue ops.

luca_ops: Also filing a small UX ticket to detect likely SCA cases and present alternative payment paths earlier in the checkout/invoice flow.

anna_fin: Thanks team. I'll monitor support for the remittance and mark invoice paid once settlement arrives. :thumbsup:
